subject: P2 WCAG: progress bar transition missing prefers-reduced-motion guard
body:
## Spec: Progress Bar — prefers-reduced-motion

**Priority:** P2 Bug (WCAG 2.3.3 compliance)
**Affects:** exam.html line 93 — .progress-fill transition

### Problem
exam.html line 93: `.progress-fill { transition: width 0.3s ease; }` — this transition has NO `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` guard.

All other animations in exam.html have reduced-motion guards (grade-a-flash, correct-pulse, wrong-nudge, gamePlanSection). The progress bar is the only exception. This is a WCAG 2.3.3 violation.

Users with vestibular disorders or ADHD who have set prefers-reduced-motion still see the progress bar animate on every question advance.

### Fix

Add to the existing `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` block in exam.html:

```css
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  /* existing rules... */
  .progress-fill {
    transition: none;
  }
}
```

The progress fill will still update (width changes), just without the animated transition.

### State Machine
N/A — this is a CSS-only fix, no state change.

### Acceptance Criteria
1. In a browser with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce enabled, advancing questions does NOT trigger a smooth width transition on the progress bar
2. Width still changes instantly to reflect progress (no regression in functionality)
3. With prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference, the 0.3s transition still works
4. No other animations are affected

### What NOT to Change
- The progress-fill width calculation logic
- Any other animations (they already have guards)
- Any JavaScript — this is CSS-only
